name: Hikari
source:
Although she enjoys her work as a magical girl, Hikari seems to treat it as she would any other job. She is kind, and the more level headed girl between her and Yuki. She believes in eradicating evil, and is someone who very much holds love dearly in her heart. She seems to be troubled by something at times, but does her best to make sure that she gets the job done.

From [url=http://winged-cloud.wikia.com/wiki/Hikari_(Sakura_Magical_Girls)?useskin=monobook]Winged-Cloud Wiki | Fandom powered by Wikia[/url]
